description: Needs OAuth scope sponsor:write (a Shared Forest account). Creates an unpaid order for the signed-in user and holds the spots. It charges nothing. The total must fit the spending limit the user set when connecting. The order expires after 30 minutes unless the user confirms. Returns confirm_url: give it to your user. The user logs in, accepts the terms and pays on that page. Ask the user before you call it and confirm name and total.

design_ids.description: One design_id for all trees, or one per tree.

display_name.description: Name shown on the trees, 1-32 characters, labelled Sponsored.

email.description: Optional email for the confirmation and the invoice. Default: the email of the signed-in account.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key, for example a UUID. A retry with the same key returns the same order.

link.description: Optional https link. It goes live after manual review.

link_text.description: Optional public label for the link. Requires link; approved with it.

quantity.description: Number of trees, 1-100. Larger orders get a lower unit price.

short_description.description: Optional short public description. Requires link; approved with it.

spots.description: Optional positions from find_spots, one per tree. Omit and the server picks free spots.

name: start_sponsorship
title: Start a tree sponsorship
